history.question: what is the fee structure for cse
history.answer: The one-time admission fee is Rs 10,000. The university and exam fee is about Rs 4,000 per year. The one-time admission fee for PG courses is Rs 8,000 and the refundable caution deposit is Rs 5,000. Fees can be paid online through the college portal using UPI, net banking, credit or debit card, or by demand draft in favour of ABC Institute of Technology.

history.question: bus routes
history.answer: Route 4 starts at LB Nagar at 6:30 AM and covers Dilsukhnagar, Malakpet, Nampally, Lakdikapul and Khairatabad before reaching the college at 8:25 AM. The yearly bus fee for Route 4 is Rs 25,000, as this is the longest route. Route 8 starts at Mehdipatnam at 7:00 AM, goes via Tolichowki, Shaikpet, Film Nagar and Jubilee Hills and costs Rs 20,000 per year. The yearly bus fee for Route 1 is Rs 18,000.

history.question: hostel fee structure
history.answer: The hostel fee including mess is Rs 60,000 per year for a three-sharing room, Rs 75,000 per year for a two-sharing room and Rs 1,00,000 per year for a single room with attached bathroom. A refundable hostel deposit of Rs 5,000 is collected at joining. The girls hostel has 3 blocks with rooms for 800 students and is inside the campus with restricted entry. Hostel in-time is 9:30 PM for first year students and 10:00 PM for other years.
